Publish final result of the applicants

Publishes the final results for applicants of a specific registration type.
This API can only be used when the registration period has ended and there are no applicants in draft status. If either condition is not met, the API will return an error.

Request Body schema: application/json
required
registration_type
required
string (RegistrationType)
Enum: "0" "1" "2" "3" "4"

Enum representing different types of registration. 0 = Zoning, 1 = Achievement, 2 = Affirmation, 3 = Transfer, 4 = Custom

Responses

Response Schema: application/json
code
required
number <double>

HTTP Response code

error
required
boolean

Error flag

message
required
string

Message

data
required
any
Response Schema: application/json
required
object
registration_type
required
Array of strings

Error message key if the registration type still has drafted applicants or the registration type has not ended.
Posible values: registration_type_still_has_drafted_applicants or registration_type_not_ended

message
required
string

Message, Whatever the error message is

error
required
boolean
Value: true

required
number
Value: 400

Export final result of the applicants

Exports the final result of the applicants for a specific registration type.
Response will be a file in .xls format.

registration_type

Responses

string <byte>
